Jamal (Release Lead): Quick FYI — rolling release train update: quiet window starts 2024-08-15 00:00 UTC (72h). New policy for freeze exemptions and owner handoff. TL;DR: minor patches allowed w/ approval, major schema changes blocked. See runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/release-train. Exemption requests via https://redwood.internal/forms/freeze-exempt. Please ack.

Elaine (PM): Clarify: what's considered 'minor patch'? And who is the approver chain?

Jamal (Release Lead): Minor = no DB migrations, no model schema changes, no public API contract changes. Approvers: Release Lead + Owning Platform Eng + Security for infra changes. For infra-only patches, SRE may fast-approve. Use the form and tag the approvers.

Ryan (SRE): Heads up — SLO thresholds during quiet window will be softened: rollback threshold lowered to 2x error rate baseline. We've pre-wired alerting team to auto-page on canary regressions. Update to canary check command in runbook:

Ryan (SRE): ```
# run canary smoke
curl -X POST https://ci.redwood/invoke-canary -d '{"variant":"canary","traffic":0.05}'
kubectl rollout status deployment/core-inference -n prod
```

release-bot: Canary status: canary-73 -> healthy (0.2% 5xx), latency P95 190ms :white_check_mark:

Nina (Eng): Noted. We have a model quant patch slated for Tuesday — it's a minor patch (no schema). Requesting exemption now.

Jamal (Release Lead): Received. @Nina we need the form + short test plan in the PR description. I'll queue for approval.

Elaine (PM): Also, exec asked for a one-line changelog for the weekly digest. Can everyone paste a 1-liner of what landed this week in their area by EOD?

Ryan (SRE): 1-liner: Redis cache sharding fix + canary throttling controls.

Nina (Eng): 1-liner: model runtime quantization roll forward (safety guarded).

Jamal (Release Lead): 1-liner: release train quiet window + new exemption workflow; freeze until Monday 00:00 UTC. Anyone with urgent hotfixes, ping me directly.

Elaine (PM): Ack :thumbsup:

Jamal (Release Lead): Thanks all — will post final rollup and approval list here when exemptions are processed.
